subject: Mutual Success Plan: contracting runway, terms leads, and redline playbook
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lisa Wang <lisa.wang@nimblehealth.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Success Plan: contracting runway, terms leads, and redline playbook

Hi all,

Thanks for the productive evaluation sessions last week — NimbleHealth's technical team looks like a great fit for our low-latency embedding use case. Per our conversation, I'd like to formalize a short Mutual Success Plan (MSP) so procurement and legal have clear next steps toward contract execution.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm the primary terms owner for NimbleHealth (who will own redlines and PO/contract approval).
- Agree on a contracting runway with milestone dates (SOW sign, pilot start, production go-live).
- Confirm preferred redline process (DocuSign vs. tracked Word comments vs. shared Drive).

Proposed near-term schedule:
- Today (May 10): identify terms owners + share SOW draft
- May 12: 1st-pass redlines due
- May 14: Legal alignment meeting if necessary
- May 20: Sign + kickoff pilot

Action for internal Redwood: Jordan — can you prep the SOW/SOW summary and procurement timeline? Marissa — will you volunteer to coordinate contracting cadence with their procurement team?

Attached is a 1-page redline playbook I put together (redline_instructions.docx) — it outlines our preferred turnaround times and what we consider deal blockers vs. items we can accept in later amendments. Please review and call out any required changes.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

[Attachment: redline_instructions.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lisa Wang <lisa.wang@nimblehealth.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Success Plan: contracting runway, terms leads, and redline playbook

Thanks Hannah — happy to coordinate.

Quick answers and updates:
- Internal terms owner: I recommend Karthik as the primary terms/legal contact for this deal; he will shepherd the redline process on the Redwood side and escalate any non-standard legal asks.
- Attached: draft SOW (Nimble_SOW_v1.pdf) and a proposed procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.xlsx) that maps milestones to our internal approval gates. Jordan — I added a column for your inputs on pilot metrics.

A few notes on the redline process:
- Our preference: tracked changes in Word for substantive commercial/legal edits + a single consolidated redline file uploaded to the DocuSign envelope.
- For quick clarifications (definitions, scheduling), we can handle via email and capture as addenda rather than blocking sign.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to confirm turnaround SLAs for legal review (we typically do 48–72h for first-pass redlines).
2) Nimble to nominate their legal/PO owner and confirm they can accept Word with tracked changes or prefer DocuSign comments.
3) Hannah/Jordan to schedule a 30-minute contracting alignment call (suggest May 11 or 12).

Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

[Attachments: Nimble_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF), procurement_timeline.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Lisa Wang <lisa.wang@nimblehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Success Plan: contracting runway, terms leads, and redline playbook

Hi Hannah / Marissa / team — thanks for the clear plan and the documents.

NimbleHealth side:
- Procurement lead: procurement@nimblehealth.com (cc'd) will be the primary for PO and billing.
- Legal reviewer: My counsel, Rahul Mehta (rahul.mehta@nimblehealth.com), will handle the redlines — he prefers tracked Word comments but can work in DocuSign if needed.

Timeline constraints from our side:
- We have a board finance cut-off week of May 18 for any material contract changes that require additional approvals. If we can't have an agreed SOW and commercial terms submitted by May 16, the earliest sign date slips to May 25.
- Procurement can generally return first-pass redlines within 72 hours once they have the consolidated draft.

We can do a contracting alignment call on May 12 at 10:00am PT — that works for our procurement and legal. I'll send a calendar invite.

Lisa Wang
VP of Product Operations | NimbleHealth
lisa.wang@nimblehealth.com | +1 617-555-2401

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Wang <lisa.wang@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Success Plan: contracting runway, terms leads, and redline playbook

Appreciate the context — I'm happy to own the Redwood side for terms. A few concrete items so everyone knows the process: 

Redline playbook (summary):
- First-pass: submit a single tracked Word file with all redlines consolidated. Turnaround: 48 business hours for material changes, 24 hours for clarifications.
- Escalation: Anything that changes data residency, customer data handling, or indemnity language will require an escalation to our Legal Director (cc me and I will flag).
- Signature flow: we will prepare the DocuSign envelope once both parties agree on a consolidated Word redline — this prevents multiple parallel envelopes.

Links / artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-12345
- DocuSign draft (placeholder envelope for SOW): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?powFormId=abc123-def456

I'll review Nimble_SOW_v1.pdf and post a short comment summary in the shared Drive before the May 12 alignment call. If Nimble's counsel (Rahul) sends tracked changes, that's fine — we'll merge and respond.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[Note: I will upload the redline template and the consolidated checklist to the drive following this thread.]
